summary: Compression spring (helical, closed ends, optionally tapered or ground), axis on z, origin at the bottom end (center=false).

checks.source: NopSCADlib's peg_spring: OD 6.4, wire 0.9, uncompressed length 15.5 (library list). The swept 16-sided wire uses radius wire/2 - eps (eps = 1/128) and its end faces land ~0.02 under nominal, so tol 0.03 covers the tessellation
